visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white cat with dark spots on its head and ears sits on a light-colored wooden staircase. It blinks slowly and looks around with its green eyes. The surrounding environment is an indoor home with bright, natural lighting coming from an unseen source. A hand with a gold ring is visible at times. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up where a person's hand forms a circular shape with the thumb and forefinger. A small brown freeze-dried treat is held against the side of the circle. The white cat sniffs the hand intently, its nose twitching as it tries to figure out how to reach the food. (3) A tortoiseshell cat is shown in a different part of the room. The person presents the same hand-circle treat challenge. This cat looks confused initially but then cleverly maneuvers its head around the hand to successfully grab the treat. The background shows a floor mat and a window. (4) The video cuts to a tabby cat being tested. It sniffs the hand-circle briefly but loses interest quickly and walks away toward a white appliance. A final ginger and white cat is tested in a kitchen area; it stares at the treat and then reaches around the hand to eat it.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, friendly female voice begins narrating over an upbeat acoustic guitar and drum BGM. The speaker explains a cat IQ test involving a hand circle and a treat. The audio is clear with no noticeable background noise, sounding like a high-quality field recording. (2) A distinct "pop" sound effect triggers as the narrator calls the first cat, "Yia." The BGM continues steadily at 115 BPM. The speaker laughs and provides animated commentary as the cat attempts to reach the treat, her voice displaying high arousal and positive valence. (3) A second "pop" SFX occurs as the scene transitions to testing the tortoiseshell cat. The narrator's voice remains energetic and playful, reacting with amusement when the cat bites her hand. The acoustic guitar BGM provides a consistent rhythmic bed underneath the speech and sound effects. (4) A "ding" SFX sounds when the final cat successfully solves the puzzle. The speaker expresses loud excitement, her pitch rising sharply. She ends the video with a lighthearted remark about female cats being smarter as the music and vocal track reach a natural conclusion.
